author: JeTePardonne
body:
A player sent me these clips with no time stamps, so I tried to make some of my own. Watch everything in like .25. If anyone wonders his ping was 104.

Personally I do not think he is hacking. Some things look sketchy, but also plausible. Does not hurt to get more opinions! :)

CLIP 1: https://youtu.be/5FvzZvdGCaM
2:40-2:48 : He hits the player from across the water, which is 5 blocks. It's the hit he sneaks in before jumping for the next, and before the other player gets across the water. 

3:22-3:32 : Begins to fight dubstep, after he hits her off his head locks directly on to someone who is underground, then back to dubstep again. Then whiling jumping down to fight the other player, while midair dubstep unshifts and he locks onto her right away. After killing her then directly locks on to the other player.

3:39 - 3:53 : He was facing the wrong way, but does a 180 to perfectly lock onto dubstep. The rest of the fight he constantly locks onto multiple players of the 3 perfectly. When the 3rd player comes into his view, he immediately locks on to them. At 3:48 He hits Vyh5 but then locks on to Vyh4 as they come into range, even with Vyh5 practically inside of him. 

4:38 : He snaps onto falz when he comes into range. 

6:32 - 6:39 : I'm not even sure what that was...the hits he lands on dubstep are sketchy, especially since he didn't have any room to move. Not to mention the weird thing with this head.

7:06 : His last hit on the first kill was 5-6 blocks.

7:47: His head directly lands on Flimbi for the last hit, then locks on to Vyh4 directly. 

8:18 His head aims perfectly on to Vyh midair from second to last hit to last hit.

CLIP 2: https://youtu.be/qyS4lmOq2NU

:40 - :43 : Sketchy hits on falz

1:25 : After being knocked off the bridge he still locks onto the player while he is falling off too, consistently staying locked on to the target.  

3:03: While on the glass, Fouled hits him and he goes straight up instead of back. I can't really tell if there is glass behind him due to the texture pack, but it looks like there is not. You would be able to see the outline of at least the top of the glass if there was any.

4:20 : Same as last time stamp, but this time there clearly isn't any glass behind him. He just takes no kb in this case at all.

5:05 : He hits falz from a far away distance (5 blocks) 

6:57 : withouts kills the first player, but then when he hits the other one to the side his head immediately locks on to the player directly. 

8:44 : Snaps to flimbi while passing him. This one can go either way really, he could of saw him, but the way his head snaps on to him seems sketchy.


If you slow down a lot of his fights he lands the same kind of hits and stuff. Like I said before I don't think he is hacking, but you never know.

P.S. If anyone else finds anything sketchy and it isn't included, if you could edit it and add it I'd appreciate it, or if you have any other evidence add it to the post.
